_readme: Cross-language conformance for COMPLETION BINDING: reading the move out of a model's
structured tool call, and reducing it to the canonical string a bound decision stores.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Three implementations of this logic exist — the Go gateway
(internal/movebind), the Python SDK (pyyol.movetools) and the JS SDK (src/movetools.ts) —
and nothing in any of them forces the three to agree. Each language's own tests would
keep passing while they quietly diverged.
A divergence here does not land as a visible bug. It lands as an HONEST TURN BEING
REJECTED: the gateway reduces the model's answer one way, the match compares it against a
move the SDK reduced another way, they differ, and the platform tells a developer their
agent did not play what its model chose. That is the worst possible failure of this
mechanism, so the canonical forms are pinned here rather than in three test suites.
Each case gives a provider response exactly as it arrives on the wire, plus the tool name
to look for and the canonical move all three implementations must produce. expect_move of
null means NOTHING MAY BE BOUND — those cases matter most, because binding a wrong move
rejects honest play while binding nothing merely leaves a turn unverified.

cases.name: openai_chat_tool_call
cases.why: The most common shape. Arguments arrive as a JSON STRING, not an object.

cases.name: openai_responses_function_call
cases.why: The Responses API uses a flat output array with type=function_call.

cases.name: anthropic_tool_use_with_leading_text
cases.why: Anthropic sends arguments as an OBJECT, and a reasoning model normally emits a text block before the tool_use one. Stopping at the first block would find no move.

content.text: The pool is small, so I will spend low.

cases.name: google_function_call
cases.why: Gemini nests the call under candidates[].content.parts[].functionCall with args as an object.

cases.name: last_tool_call_wins
cases.why: A model that corrects itself stands behind its FINAL answer. Binding the first would let an agent pin a move with a throwaway call.

cases.name: quoted_number_is_the_same_decision
cases.why: A model that wrote "7" instead of 7 made the same move. Rejecting the formatting habit would leave honest agents permanently unbound.

cases.name: prose_binds_nothing
cases.why: The platform must never parse a move out of free text. 'I play the 7' is not a tool call, and guessing would make enforcement unfair and evadable.

cases.name: another_tool_binds_nothing
cases.why: A call to some other tool the developer defined is not a move.

cases.name: fractional_card_binds_nothing
cases.why: 7.5 is not a card. Rounding it would invent a move the model did not make, and that invented move would reject the agent's honest one.

cases.name: missing_card_binds_nothing
cases.why: A tool call with no card names no move. Defaulting to 0 would bind a move the model never chose.

cases.name: mafia_night_kill
cases.why: Mafia binds the verb and target only. The PHASE is server state, not the model's choice, so binding it would reject an honest turn over a field the model had no say in.

cases.name: mafia_absent_target_is_no_target_not_seat_zero
cases.why: Seat 0 is a real player. Defaulting a missing target to 0 would bind an action against that player which the model never named.

cases.name: mafia_explicit_negative_target_is_no_target
cases.why: -1 is the wire convention for 'no seat' and must reduce identically to an omitted target, or one encoding of the same abstain would reject the other.

cases.name: mafia_seat_zero_is_a_real_target
cases.why: The other half of the rule above: seat 0 must stay distinguishable from no target, or a move against that one player could be substituted for doing nothing.

cases.name: mafia_verb_case_is_normalized
cases.why: A model that emitted 'Vote' chose the same action. Case is cosmetic and must not reject a turn.

cases.name: monopoly_buy_renders_all_three_fields
cases.why: Property and amount are always rendered, including zeros, so that 'mortgage property 0 for 50' and 'mortgage property 50 for 0' cannot reduce to one string.

cases.name: monopoly_bid_with_amount
cases.why: An amount-bearing action keeps its amount in the canonical form.

cases.name: monopoly_property_and_amount_do_not_collide
cases.why: The specific collision the three-field form prevents. This case and the next differ only by which field holds 50.

cases.name: monopoly_property_and_amount_do_not_collide_reversed
cases.why: The pair to the case above: a different decision must produce a different string.

cases.name: wrong_game_tool_binds_nothing
cases.why: A Mafia tool call must not be readable as a Goofspiel move, or an agent in one game could bind a move shaped for another.

cases.name: empty_response_binds_nothing
cases.why: An error page or an empty body must leave the turn unverified rather than produce a move.

cases.name: bedrock_converse_tooluse
cases.why: AWS Bedrock Converse nests the call under output.message.content[].toolUse with input as an object. No Bedrock-specific code exists: it works because name and its arguments are siblings.

cases.name: cohere_v2_tool_call
cases.why: Cohere v2 puts tool calls under message.tool_calls[].function with arguments as a JSON string. Never coded for; the structure is the same.

cases.name: mistral_openai_wire
cases.why: Mistral speaks the OpenAI wire format. Covered without a Mistral branch.

cases.name: vllm_selfhosted_openai_wire
cases.why: A self-hosted vLLM/SGLang/llama.cpp server emitting the OpenAI shape. Open-source servers are the case a vendor table can never keep up with.

cases.name: ollama_native_tool_call
cases.why: Ollama's native (non-OpenAI) shape puts the call under message.tool_calls[].function with arguments as an OBJECT, not a string.

cases.name: unknown_future_provider_shape
cases.why: A shape nobody has shipped: an invented envelope with the same name+args siblings. This is the whole point of a structural walk — a provider works on the day it appears, with no release.

cases.name: echoed_tool_schema_binds_nothing
cases.why: THE dangerous near-miss. A response echoing the tool DEFINITION has name plus a JSON Schema under 'parameters'. Accepting 'parameters' as arguments would read a definition as a call. It must bind nothing, not a wrong move.

cases.name: deepseek_openai_wire_tool_call
cases.why: DeepSeek speaks the OpenAI wire format for tool calls, so no DeepSeek branch is needed. Its CACHE fields differ and are handled in usage normalization, not here.
